song.name: Echoes of Stone
song.plot: Eldrin Nightshade sits in his tower, surrounded by dust and silence. He studies the geological strata of the world, noticing a terrifying anomaly—"Echoes" in the stone that suggest the world has ended before. He feels the weight of a history he cannot read, and a premonition that the cycle is about to repeat.
song.analysis: The original lyrics are poetic and atmospheric but lack specific lore anchors. The reworked version threads in Eldrin's role as a scholar uncovering the erased history at 0 GD, mentions the Stormbringer's call, and sets up his burden as future guardian.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: A solitary figure, cloaked in shadow, Wandering through the night, so hollow. Towering spires, ancient scripts unfold, Whispers of the past, stories untold.
section.reworked: A solitary figure, cloaked in shadow, Searching through the archives, so hollow. Towering spires, ancient scripts unfold, The Great Darkness, stories half-told.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: Echoes of stone, in the silence they cry, Secrets of ages, beneath the sky. Time stands still, in this frozen echo, A heart heavy with secrets, longing to let go.
section.reworked: Echoes of stone, in the silence they cry, Secrets of ages, beneath the sky. Time stands still, in this silent era, A heart heavy with the Gap, longing to know.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: Wind whispers through empty halls, so cold, Memories linger, in the walls of old. Footsteps fade, in the dust of time, Lost in the echoes, a forgotten rhyme.
section.reworked: Wind whispers through empty halls, so cold, The 0 GD secrets, in the walls of old. Footsteps fade, in the dust of time, A world-shattering event, a forgotten rhyme.

section.reworked: The Stormbringer calls, through the spire so cold, A vision of violet, a story of old. The needle spins, in the hands of time, Averting the fall, a cosmic climb.

section.name: Bridge
section.original: In the shadows, where the light can't reach, A soul searching, for the truth to breach. Through the darkness, a glimmer of hope, In the echoes of stone, we learn to cope.
section.reworked: In the shadows, where the light can't reach, A soul searching, to prevent the breach. Through the darkness, a glimpse of the unknown, In the echoes of stone, I walk alone.

section.name: Outro
section.original: A solitary figure, cloaked in shadow, Finding peace, in the night so shallow. Echoes of stone, fade into the night, A heart unburdened, taking flight.
section.reworked: A solitary figure, cloaked in shadow, Guarding the future, in the night so shallow. Echoes of stone, fade into the night, A heart burdened with time, taking flight.
